objs.name: document
objs.description: Central managed information object representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other controlled documents in DHC VISION, subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction) determining its level in the document pyramid.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation prefix with consecutive number assigned to the document (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document, incremented upon revision or changes.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope or area of applicability of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the current released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time period (default 3 years) after which the document must be checked for continued validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period (default 10 years) for archived documents before physical deletion.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data referenced by this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications linked to the document via its properties.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or entities for which the document is relevant.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Organizational or geographic areas where the document applies.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person registered as the primary author of the document, automatically set to the creator but changeable.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons assigned write permissions on the document alongside the author.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check the document content for technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) responsible for approving and releasing the document for distribution.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment controlling which readers may view the released document.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute controlling email notification distribution when a new version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute controlling acknowledgement-based distribution requiring active confirmation from recipients.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language of the document content, relevant for translation management.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: In a multi-client system, specifies in which clients the document is visible.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new documents, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled supplementary document attached to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document's release cycle.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment, maintained independently but following the main document's release process.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the attachment within the release process of the main document.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary information object attached to a document that is not subject to the main document's release cycle and can be published directly via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changing an existing document, managed in the document's cockpit, trackable and printable in the document for information purposes.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend, revise, or invalidate the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request to invalidate a document and archive it, triggering a workflow process for out-of-force declaration.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, created by the Business Admin group in a designated folder.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Named group of users used for assigning read, change, and distribution authorizations to documents (e.g. Reader - Document Management, Authors, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive).

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person in DHC VISION who can be assigned roles and authorizations for document management activities.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user determining available functions (e.g. Reader, Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, Business Admin).

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which the user logs into the system, determining which language version of documents is displayed.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and individual persons maintained per document that controls email notifications, acknowledgement requests, and dashboard assignments.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process automating approval steps including creator sign-off, review, and release, with email notifications and electronic signatures.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature applied by workflow participants to confirm completion of their workflow tasks, documented per released version.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational entity within the company structure to which documents and processes can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Business process managed in DHC VISION that can be linked to documents for process-specific filing and navigation.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk object in DHC VISION that can be linked to documents through database integration.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Reference data objects (e.g. IT applications) that can be linked to documents through the system's database integration.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific user interface view displaying relevant documents, tasks, and evaluation information based on the user's group assignments and distribution lists.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Evaluation report providing filtered information about documents in the system based on selection parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Type of report such as Status Report: Documents & Instruction, Document Monitoring, Status Report for Acknowledgement.

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: Configurable filter criteria that influence the evaluation results and result lists.

attributes.name: traffic_light_status
attributes.description: Visual indicator system (green, yellow, red) showing document validity or workflow progress status.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Tenant or organizational entity in a multi-client DHC VISION system where documents can be made visible but not changed.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Active confirmation by a user that they have taken note of a released document version, tracked and summarized for authors and key roles.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is still pending.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A user creates a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object, selecting the document type and optionally a template, and maintaining its properties and metadata.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The document template chosen during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: An author or co-author edits the content of a document using the integrated editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: A user maintains or updates the metadata and attributes of a document through the properties editing dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The system automatically converts a saved document to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: The system creates a new editing version of a released document when changes to content, properties, or attachments are made.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The new version number assigned to the editing version.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: An author or co-author initiates the 3-step release workflow (Creator - Review - Release) for a document.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the creator step as the first step of the release workflow using an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and formal correctness as part of the release workflow.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, making it visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the release workflow, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: The system automatically publishes a document after release, making it visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: An author adds a controlled attachment to a document, triggering creation of a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An author modifies an existing attachment, triggering creation of a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Previously archived attachments are reactivated together with the reactivation of the main document.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An author adds supplementary information to a document that is not subject to the main document's release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An author deletes additional information from a document without affecting the main document's version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A user with author rights creates a change proposal for a document, notifying the document author by email.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of the change proposal, notifying the proposal creator and removing it from display in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: A releaser (or author, reviewer and releaser) confirms the document's continued validity, deleting the request and updating the valid-until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document, automatically starting the override workflow.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: A releaser (or Creator, reviewer and releaser) completes the override process, setting the document status to out of force, revoking authorizations and starting the archive duration.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate a previously invalidated document in the designated folder.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: The initiator confirms the reactivation, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata, authorizations, and distribution list.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: The system physically deletes archived documents after the archive duration has expired.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: The system sends email notifications to users and user groups on the distribution list when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: The system sends acknowledgement requests by email to users and user groups on the distribution for acknowledgement list upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user actively confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via a workflow-supported task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator translates released document content into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated document version is checked and released with workflow support, making it visible to readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: assign_user_to_user_group
evts.description: Technical administration assigns a user to a user group, determining their available authorizations and role capabilities.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: An author maintains the distribution list in the document cockpit, assigning user groups and persons for notification and acknowledgement.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: A user generates an evaluation report with selected parameters and criteria to search and filter documents in the system.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: The type of report being generated.

o2o.description: Each document type can have one or more document templates defined for selection when creating new documents.
A document can have one or more controlled attachments that are versioned and released with the main document.
A document can be supplemented with additional information objects not subject to the main document's release cycle.
Change proposals belong to a specific document and are managed in the document's cockpit.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document whose validity needs to be checked.
A request for override is created for a specific document to initiate its invalidation and archiving.
A request for reactivation references the specific invalidated document selected for reactivation.
Each document has a distribution list maintained in its cockpit controlling notification and acknowledgement distribution.
Documents can reference other documents through the References attribute.
Documents can be linked to processes for process-specific filing and navigation.
Documents can be linked to organizational units through database integration.
Documents can be linked to risks through database integration.
Documents can be linked to master data objects such as IT applications.
Distribution lists contain user groups whose members receive notifications and dashboard assignments.
Distribution lists can contain individual persons in addition to user groups.
Users are assigned to user groups which determine their authorizations and role capabilities.
Document release, validity extension, override and reactivation processes are supported by workflows.
Released documents trigger acknowledgement tasks for users on the distribution for acknowledgement list.
In a multi-client system, documents can be configured for visibility across specific clients.
Workflow participants complete their tasks with electronic signatures documented per released version.
Dashboards are filled based on user group assignments in the distribution list, displaying relevant documents for users in those groups.
An acknowledgement is confirmed by an individual user for a specific document version.
